text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In this world,
there are three kinds of people.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“The victors and the defeated.
And then—”

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: "The strongest," indeed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The Grande Dame, Gentildonna.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was born to a father who rose to the top in a single generation purely through strength.
He preached the importance of "strength" to his children—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Father
text_block_list.text:
Power means wealth, talent,
authority... and ambition. Thus, my father—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Father
text_block_list.text:
For your sake,
I shall entrust the family succession to 'the strongest'.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—In that case, naturally,
the family headship is mine.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Because...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I am,
after all, very strong.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I possess a power that is beautiful, mighty,
and yet so delicate.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed, this magnificent power...
It would be dreadfully boring to wield it merely for the sake of succession."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"As an Umamusume blessed with supreme power,
there is an apex where I must stand—"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Race!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
My only weapons are my mind and my body.
I will pour everything I have into my running... and seize victory!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
The simplest, most splendid proof of power—
permitted only to us!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"The time is ripe.
Now is the moment—"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to demonstrate the proof
of who is 'mightiest of all' on the track.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together with my new trainee Gentildonna,
our days of full-fledged training began
with our sights set on the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—Huff... huff...
Hah!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Did... did Gentil-san just use
a barbell like a dumbbell...?"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"It's not enough after all.
Too light."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"That was the maximum weight plate... wasn't it!?
That's insane...!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A & B
text_block_list.text:
Eep.
L-Let's go...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Oh.
And I was only looking.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My trainee, Gentildonna, radiates an immense presence
around her with her formidable power
and majestic demeanor.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume possess strength far greater than humans, but hers stands out even among her peers.
And it is not merely raw power, either—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: So, Trainer. When do you think you'll place the additional order for plates?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so you hadn't noticed?
That it's about time we increase the workload.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
If that is the case, very well.
I will make the arrangements myself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Truly a master of both the literary and military arts. Striving daily for strength, her standard is exceptionally high—slack off for even a moment, and you'll be left in the dust.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, let's do it in the coming days.
Otherwise, it will interfere with training."

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
...You're pretty strict, Gentildonna.
I think I'd lose all my confidence if I were them.

text_block_list.name: Trainer B
text_block_list.text:
That Trainer looks like a rookie, too...
I wonder if they can handle it~

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Warm-up is done.
Next up is...—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Please, feast your eyes upon this.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Hmphhh!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"With a thunderous roar, Gentildonna
sprints across the track.
That breathtaking run of hers was..."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Phew...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Then, I would like to hear
Trainer's opinion.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna's running today was nearly flawless.
The form issues I pointed out previously
have been completely corrected.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Right now...
yes.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I shall continue my training.
Keep your eyes peeled and analyze me thoroughly.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: It is as though even those eyes can see the heights I am destined to reach.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing the full round of training...
I hold a meeting with Gentildonna
about our future plans.
choice_data_list: So, about the big goal we're aiming for...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
First is the Triple Tiara.
We talked about this before, remember?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Classic races, which an Umamusume can only run once in her lifetime.
Those primary paths diverge into two routes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna's goal is the illustrious Triple Tiara route,
consisting of the Oka Sho, the Yushun Himba (Oaks),
and the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The reason she chose that path was—
utterly lighthearted and charming.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Tiara...
will suit me quite well, won't it?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She casts a meaningful glance my way.
It's not merely a test of aesthetic judgment.
—It's to confirm whether we stand at the exact same perspective.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Others have told me I could win the Derby too,
and recommended the Classic Triple Crown route,
though?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Classic Triple Crown route... Consisting of the Satsuki Sho, Japanese Derby, and Kikuka-sho, it's another premier path.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby) in particular is considered the pinnacle of domestic prestige, and being a Derby Umamusume is proof of true strength. However—
choice_data_list: (Gentildonna's strength doesn't depend on the path she takes.)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Now then,
how is it?
choice_data_list: Your tiara will shine brighter than any crown.
Your tiara will shine brighter than any crown.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, exactly.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'll be off. As for the
training details starting tomorrow, more on that later.
choice_data_list: Oh yeah, about those extra weight plates...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Plate...
Ah, from this morning."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Regarding the extra resistance she requested during morning training... I just tracked down a supplier who could handle it immediately and placed an additional order.
choice_data_list: The rest should arrive by tomorrow

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...Oh.
You're quite early, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Did you perhaps do some online shopping?
choice_data_list: I contacted every single Umamusume-dedicated gym I could find.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...
So there's no issue with quality, then.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: We were saved by luck, weren't we?
choice_data_list: Luck or not, I'll take whatever advantage I can get.
Luck or whatever it is, I'll use anything I can.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I certainly still have plenty of room to grow as a Trainer.
However... I have no intention of letting my thoughts stop there.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Fufu...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Now then, please,
go ahead and swing to your heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"I have high expectations...
for your assistance."
